title: Sync
summary: Peer-to-peer sync between the devices of one book, over the local network.
description: The author's phone and computers hold the same book. They sync as the shared part Tandem says, the book being its collection; this part holds what syncing a book adds to that.

stories.as: an author who writes on more than one device
stories.want: the same book on each of them
stories.soThat: I can pick up wherever I left off

requirements.text: Two instances of the app on the same local network can sync their databases with each other.

requirements.text: Devices find each other as Murmur does: each announces itself on the local network (mDNS, with its sync port and the book's tag) and looks for the others, and is tried at every address it announced, IPv6 and IPv4, all at once; the UDP broadcast and each peer's last known address are tried too.

history.text: Devices find each other by UDP broadcast and by probing each peer's last known address.
history.reason: The author's computer and phone never reached each other this way, while Murmur, which finds its devices by mDNS and tries every address they announce, does on the same devices: Commonplace finds its devices as Murmur does.
